name: Hamma Hamma G.S.
summary: CCC-built Hamma Hamma guard station in Olympic National Forest, planned in 1936 as a combined guard station and lookout; still standing and rented as a Forest Service cabin.
design: Single-story CCC guard station with a hexagonal bay window in the living room; 1936 plans called it a combined guard station and lookout
agency: USDA Forest Service, Olympic National Forest

access.note: Rented to guests as a Forest Service cabin. A short gated road leads up to it, and the gate may or may not be open. Visitors who are not guests should check with the Forest Service before going.

visit.trail_note: The Living Legacy (Living Legend) trail follows the Hamma Hamma River from the cabin, 1.8 miles round trip, with signs about the CCC.

events.note: Constructed by the CCC in 1936-37 as the guard station
Planning papers describe a guard on patrol who had to leave duty to unlock the fire-season gate below the station
